mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 5.2% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) signal reduced household spending capacity, depressing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals robust manufacturing capacity utilization, strengthening corporate profit outlooks and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 3.5% triggers anticipated Federal Reserve tightening that increases real borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly real GDP growth above 1.0% signals strong economic expansion that elevates corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.0% quarterly.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal labor market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises by at least 0.1 percentage points monthly.

mechanism_narrative: High consumer credit growth (RSAFS > 0.8% monthly) signals robust household spending capacity, strengthening retail sector performance and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS growth exceeds 0.8% monthly.
